d:
This is my first upload. Hopefully it looks okay. Some random commentary:

I was searching and testing workflows to create translated comics. After spending a significant time creating custom scripts to interact and run Koharu, this translated work is the result of that. I originally just did it for myself, but I figured it would benefit the community, so here we are.

I know machine translated works are not looked fondly upon here, but consider this: these type of work are not typically translated *Fine I'll do it myself Meme*. They're also very long, often in the thousands of pages. Try to calculate how much it would cost to commission this many pages, and you'll see why machine assistance is needed to create these type of work. To that end...

I've spent significant time going over this work. Even if we discount the time to refine the workflow and scripts, every page was looked over for obvious errors, and if needed, manually adjusting and editing things like SFX, removing third-party watermarks, etc. It was read from start to finish and it read fine to me. I did not obsess over every page, so I can't guarantee things didn't slip through. However, if I'd read this work here, I wouldn't have had any objections, which is the bar I set.

I'm not sure about the title, as it's ambiguous if "rose" is plural or not in the original title. It depends on if one or both the female characters are "roses", as only one character is specifically referred to as a "rose". In the end I settled on "roses" as the story is shared between the characters, removing a potential second "the" to give a more poetic feeling.

This work and the first chapter unfortunately doesn't have a title page. As such, I settled on using an image of one of the characters, released outside of the regular chapters.
